name: Global edge networking: Route 53, CloudFront and Global Accelerator

lesson.summary: Edge networking brings content and routing closer to users. Amazon Route 53 is a DNS service that translates domain names to IP addresses and routes users to AWS or non-AWS resources. Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches copies of content near users. AWS Global Accelerator sends user traffic onto the AWS global network and fails over quickly when an application location becomes unhealthy.
keyPoints: DNS translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses
Amazon Route 53 is a DNS service that also registers domain names and routes users to AWS or non-AWS resources
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches copies of content at locations close to users
AWS Global Accelerator directs user traffic through the AWS global network and routes around unhealthy application locations
Route 53, CloudFront and Global Accelerator often work together in a multi-Region design

scenarios.text: A financial company must deliver training videos and static content to consultants around the world with low latency. Separately, a media company wants one service to register its domain names and route traffic to resources both in AWS and elsewhere.

questions.prompt: What is the primary function of a DNS service?

options.text: It translates human-readable domain names to machine-readable IP addresses
It filters inbound and outbound traffic to EC2 instances
It provisions a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud
It creates a subsection of a VPC

questions.explanation: DNS translates domain names into IP addresses, like a phone book for the internet. Filtering traffic is a job for security groups and network ACLs, and provisioning or subdividing a VPC are separate networking tasks.

questions.prompt: Which service best delivers the training videos and static content with low latency?
questions.explanation: CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches copies of content near users, which gives low latency for videos and static content. Global Accelerator routes traffic rather than caching content, Route 53 resolves domain names, and a VPC is a private network.

questions.prompt: Which service lets the media company register and manage its domain names and route traffic to resources both in AWS and elsewhere?
questions.explanation: Route 53 is a DNS service that registers and manages domain names and routes users to AWS and non-AWS resources. CloudFront caches content, Direct Connect is a network link, and Global Accelerator routes traffic without managing domain names.

questions.prompt: A customer wants traffic routing that reacts quickly when an application location becomes unhealthy. Which service fits best?
questions.explanation: Global Accelerator directs traffic through the AWS global network and fails over quickly when a location is unhealthy. The other options do not route traffic around unhealthy application locations.

questions.prompt: Type the name of the AWS content delivery network service.
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches copies of content near users.
